reason: The named lab and a report matching the batch number is what I normally have to hunt for, and the empty-box guarantee means I can try one box without much risk. The pre-counted sachet helps because I forget things on the counter anyway.
objection: Two capsules every day is a lot to keep up with, and I forget my vitamins half the time. I would also want to open the lab report and check it is real before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report did not open, did not name the lab, or did not match the batch number on the box, I would not buy.
